title: So I Bought Those Weird New AliExpress Retro PCs…
summary: LGR reviews the Book 8088 and Hand 386, newly built DOS retro PCs sold on AliExpress that use real legacy chips on custom boards. He covers what is neat about them and their compromises and odd design decisions.
why: Linked when retro hardware, 8088 or 386 machines, or oddball AliExpress computers come up.
